address: Çırkan Mahallesi, Çelebi Kaptan Sokak No:3/A, Konacık, Bodrum, 48400, Türkiye
bio: If you're on the hunt for a lively place in which to have lunch among the locals, look no further. Kismet Lokantasi serves delicious food at great value for money in a laid-back atmosphere. Peruse the counter for traditional delicacies prepared by the chef, then choose your favourites. Think succulent meatballs with grilled aubergine and tomato sauce, and, for dessert, a rich patisserie with walnuts and just the right amount of sweet syrup – foodies will be in seventh heaven! This indulgent dining experience will leave a lasting impression.
